svg.title: Project Haruka cosmic stage: proposed normalized side construction
svg.desc: Native-vector side elevation of the existing 15-group high-intensity candidate. Visible evidence and proposed depth reconstruction are distinguished. No measured dimensions, tested 3D scene, unrestricted camera, canon cosmology or performance claim.

g.text: Project Haruka v4 • 15-group high-intensity candidate • proposed screen-oriented staging
All depths below are design coordinates. They are NOT measurements from the artwork.
H label: proposed placement / hidden form
x omitted; solids use centerline sections; off-axis star pieces are projected
L11–14 / one contact rig + load path
READ THIS AS A BUILD HYPOTHESIS
Two people meet at one hand contact.
The standing figure has a foothold.
An immense inverted mass and crack.
Dense, uneven star clusters / black gaps.
All z positions, y heights and thicknesses.
Back corners, hidden faces and foot locks.
Five star pieces in three depth families.
O1: near beam stops the ray to a star.
O2: mass stops the ray to a rear corner.
Dashed ray portions are hidden from C.
These are designed tests, not image proof.
Dots mark placement, not star density.
Keep L07 off the opaque mass silhouette.
“Front” is relative to its own band only.
Cutaway corner: top + wall + underside / hidden return
H: section thickness t = 0.40 U for both tiers.
V: thickness cues. H: these dimensions / full loop.
Side arms sit outside the centerline section in A.
Enlarged rig constraint, not an anatomical pose study
V: contact and visible support. H: exact foot anchors.
Lock L12 + L13 together; attach feet to L11 surface.
L14 occludes locally; reflections stay separate.
1 U = schematic standing-figure height; not meters.
SCOPE: fixed hero view only • no camera range validated • no canon cosmology • no image segmentation • no 3D / engine / performance pass
